title: SYJ Production Genesis V2 Target Schema
description: Phase 9.2 target genesis contract. This is a schema only; no mainnet genesis is created or approved. network_id is the canonical SYJ identity.

protocol_version.description: Genesis schema/protocol major version. A different version requires a new versioned genesis contract.

network_name.description: Canonical human-readable network label. It participates in deterministic network_id derivation and is not itself the network identity.

network_id.description: Canonical 32-byte SYJ network identity encoded as lowercase hexadecimal. It MUST equal the deterministic EffectiveNetworkID derived from the genesis identity inputs.

historical_genesis_hash.description: Approved historical genesis lineage anchor. The production value is TBD — requires governance and security review.

genesis_state_commitment.description: Domain-separated SHA-256 commitment over the canonical genesis state payload excluding this field. It is distinct from the later authenticated runtime state-root algorithm.

accounts.description: Initial account state. Records MUST be unique by address and canonically sorted by address before commitment.

balance_base_units.description: Non-negative initial balance in base units.

validators.description: Initial validator records. Records MUST be unique by validator_id and consensus_key and canonically sorted by validator_id.

consensus_key.description: Canonical validator consensus public-key encoding. Exact production encoding is TBD — requires runtime/security review.

stake_base_units.description: Non-negative authenticated stake used to derive voting power; final minimum/maximum stake policy is TBD — requires governance and economic review.

staking.description: Initial staking module state/parameter container. Final staking economics remain TBD — requires governance and economic review.

governance.description: Initial governance module state/parameter container. Final governance thresholds and emergency authority remain TBD — requires governance, security, and legal review.

monetary_policy.description: Initial monetary-policy state/parameter container. Final supply, issuance, rewards, fees, burn, allocation, and vesting remain TBD — requires governance, economic, security, and legal review.

$comment: Top-level fields are frozen by the Phase 9.2 contract. Nested staking/governance/monetary-policy module fields remain semantically versioned and MUST be validated by the active module contract. No mainnet genesis or final token distribution is created by this schema.
